family_name: Polyester Solutions Wall Block - Baffle block Batts

spec.description:
Polyester Solutions
WallBlock Batts (and Ceiling Baffle Block Batts) are high-density acoustic
insulation slabs manufactured from thermally bonded polyester fiber containing a
high percentage of recycled PET. Specifically engineered to control noise and
sound vibrations in timber and steel stud wall frames, multi-residential
developments, and ceiling plenum spaces, they provide acoustic absorption (NRC
up to 1.00) and thermal protection. Sized to friction-fit into wall cavities and
stack above partition walls, they eliminate sound flanking paths without sagging
or settling.
features:
High-density acoustic batt engineered for walls
and ceiling plenum baffle blocks

Delivers superior sound absorption (NRC 0.85
at 75mm, NRC 0.95-1.00 at 90mm)

Thermally bonded polyester containing high
percentage of recycled PET beverage containers

Non-irritant, non-toxic,
odorless, and non-allergenic; safe to install without PPE

Pre-cut to fit
comfortably into wall stud frames and joists without staples

Sits firmly in
cavity without sagging, settling, or becoming brittle over time

Resists
moisture, mold, rot, insects, and vermin

Zero formaldehyde, zero chemical
binders, zero ODP

Tested to AS 1530.3 fire standards with zero spread of
flame

install:
Isolate power at main breaker before working in wall cavities or near
electrical wires

Select batt width (430mm or 580mm) matching stud spacing
(450mm or 600mm)

Friction-fit WallBlock batts between timber or steel wall
studs without gaps or folds

For ceiling baffle blocks, stack batts above
partition walls from top plate to underside of roof/slab

Compress batts
around ducting, electrical conduits, and pipes to close acoustic flanking
voids

Cut neatly around junction boxes and plumbing with heavy-duty shears or
serrated knife
Enclose behind acoustic plasterboard or wall linings promptly
selection_checklist:
Confirm stud cavity depth (75mm for R1.5 HD; 90mm
for R2.0/R2.5 HD)

Confirm stud centers (430mm for 450mm centers; 580mm
for 600mm centers)
Calculate required pack count based on square meterage
limitations:
Internal wall and ceiling plenum use; not for direct external
weather exposure
Do not compress 90mm batts into 70mm cavities

Maintain
required clearances around non-IC rated light fittings
spec.warranty:
Backed
by Polyester Solutions manufacturer product warranty

use_cases:
High-density acoustic infill in internal timber or steel stud
walls separating bedrooms, home theatres, and bathrooms

Ceiling plenum baffle
blocks stacked above partition walls to prevent room-to-room cross-talk

Acoustic and thermal insulation in multi-residential inter-tenancy walls and
hotel partitions
not_for:
Unclad external walls exposed to driving
rain
retrieval.rag_summary:
Polyester Solutions WallBlock Batts (and Baffle Block Batts) are
high-density acoustic insulation slabs manufactured from 100% thermally bonded
polyester fibers containing recycled PET plastic. Achieving superior sound
absorption ratings (NRC 0.85 at 75mm up to NRC 1.00 at 90mm R2.5), they
friction-fit into wall stud bays or stack in ceiling plenums to eliminate
airborne noise transfer and acoustic flanking. Free from formaldehyde, chemical
binders, and glass fibers, they provide non-toxic, non-sagging acoustic control
compliant with AS/NZS 4859.1 and AS 1530.3.
